text:
Marta G.: Hey team — candidate (Priyanka K) landed in SF but her flight was late. Can we confirm pick-up / transit stipend? She asked about MUNI vs rideshare.
Alex L.: Oh no — do we have a rideshare code left? If not we usually approve up to $60 for airport rides.
Samira (People Ops): Approving $60 rideshare or we can cover a Clipper card reload if she prefers public transit. Marta, can you DM her the options?
Marta G.: Will do. Also she mentioned severe nut allergy — catering for onsite panel?
Alex L.: Noted. I'll flag dietary requirement to the cafe.
Samira (People Ops): Thanks. Also quick ask: she prefers a compact mechanical keyboard (ergonomic) for the coding session — do we have a loaner?
Alex L.: We have one Logan mechanical compact in the kit closet 2F. Marta can reserve it and set it to USB-C.
Marta G.: Reserved and labelled. I'll include a sticker: "Priyanka K — please return to People Ops" :white_check_mark:
people-ops-bot: Interview reminder set: 2 hours before start; calendar invite sent to panel and candidate.
Marta G.: Panel update — Kim will be remote and asks for Zoom + live captions. Also, Kim wants a 10 min buffer between her panel and the next meeting.
Samira (People Ops): Make sure Zoom link has live captions enabled. I'll add a 10-min buffer to Kim's invite.
Alex L.: For the coding exercise environment: use image `devbox-2026-candidate` with Python 3.11 and the test dataset preloaded. Marta, can you confirm the VM will be available?
Marta G.: VM reserved on floor lab node 3. I'll drop the SSH jump details in the calendar note and pin the VM tag `pri_k_test`.
Samira (People Ops): Also, candidate asked for an expense form for commute — attach short form + receipt instructions in the follow-up email.
Marta G.: Copying receipts workflow: submit to expenses@redwood.com with subject `Candidate Travel - Priyanka K` and include timestamp + ride receipt. I'll paste it in chat for her.
Alex L.: One more — timezone confusion: candidate wrote PST but recruiter scheduled in PDT range. Confirmed it's local SF time; calendar shows correct timezone.
Samira (People Ops): Good catch. I'll send a confirmation message: `See you at 10:30 AM PT (SF office, 3rd floor, lab room B). If you'd rather remote, reply and we'll send Zoom.`
Marta G.: Sending now. :rocket:
Alex L.: Thanks all — looks covered. If anything last-minute ping #oncall or @people-ops.
